name: Portion new before-after workflow
review_scope: New stills and footage; one targeted gaze retry, no blanket model superiority claim.

runs.review: Rejected: raised eyes and horizontal stare above screen despite correct source still. Mouse grip remains plausible but gaze fails action. No final footage used.
runs.review_method: Approved source still before I2V, chronological 8-frame full sheet plus 12 enlarged face/hand frames, full decode; subjective agent review.

runs.review: Stricter chin-lowered and downward-pupil constraints retain screenward gaze better. Natural blinks and tiny mouse movement. Select 0.3–5.6s; wipe covers last 0.65s. Identity, wrist and mouse stable. Review is subjective, not eye tracking.

runs.review: Natural box-directed gaze across sampled range, preserved wardrobe and face. Fingers settle on lid then shift toward box edge: more motion than requested, but coherent packing action. No box opening or lifting. End wipe covers final hand withdrawal.
